Molly atlas eli — INFRA TICKET UPDATE: scope is two-layer.

LAYER 1 (transform — verified fix works): override next/jest transformIgnorePatterns + add allowlist entries. Verified locally via --transformIgnorePatterns CLI override that SyntaxError: Unexpected token export at node_modules/uuid/dist-node/index.js goes away. Additional ESM dep found and added: jsonpath-plus (also type:module, pulled via @genkit-ai/google-genai).

Final layer-1 allowlist: yaml|dotprompt|@genkit-ai|@radix-ui|lucide-react|uuid|jsonpath-plus|three|@react-three/fiber|@pixiv/three-vrm|geist

LAYER 2 (downstream — out of layer-1 scope): once layer 1 lands, the same tests now fail with TypeError: (0 , import_fs.existsSync) is not a function at @genkit-ai/ai/src/prompt.ts loadPromptFolder. Root cause: testEnvironment=jsdom in jest.config.mjs, but genkit calls fs synchronously during configure(). Two paths:
  (a) docblock @jest-environment node on each affected suite (5–13 files)
  (b) split jest config to two projects — node for AI/agency tests, jsdom for React UI tests

RECOMMEND: ship LAYER 1 as #226 first (small, mechanical, reversible — just swaps transformIgnorePatterns). Then evaluate layer 2 as a separate ticket — its bigger and touches test-env philosophy.
